title: 飛機系統故障樹分析
summary: 以「把故障邏輯、共因與可驗證假設分開」為主線，在飛機系統非操作故障樹工作台中依序完成任一故障觸發的OR邏輯、暴露分母與事件率、備援負載需求是否相容、診斷殘差的替代原因、組態變更後故障樹更新及專題交接。十單元各含機制、定量、驗證和診斷，全部算例明示為教學假設；比較情境由學員依模型建構，不是現場量測資料。
summaryEn: Follow Separate fault logic, common causes and verifiable assumptions in a Non-operational aircraft-system fault-tree bench, progressing through OR logic for either triggering failure, Exposure denominators and event rates, Whether backup capacity matches load, Alternative causes of diagnostic residuals, Fault-tree revision after configuration change, then a course handoff. Ten units each cover mechanisms, calculation, verification and diagnosis. All numbers are explicit teaching assumptions; learners construct scenario comparisons from the models, not field measurements.
scope: 公開原理支持的原創航空教學。每個數值均明示為假設模型，非同名機型實際性能、維修手冊、製造工藝、取證判據或飛行操作。任務在模型完成，不提供武器、軍用性能最佳化或真機操作指示。
scopeEn: Original aviation teaching based on public principles. Every numerical example is an explicit hypothetical model, not named-aircraft performance, maintenance data, manufacturing process, certification criterion or flight operation. Tasks run in models, excluding weapons, military-performance optimization and aircraft operating instructions.

steps.title: 任一故障觸發的OR邏輯：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: OR logic for either triggering failure: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 任一故障觸發的OR邏輯 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of OR logic for either triggering failure and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 在「飛機系統故障樹分析」中，本單元處理「任一故障觸發的OR邏輯」。任一事件即可導致頂事件時，獨立機率的聯集需扣掉重疊；單純相加只在小機率時近似。
steps.instructionEn: Within Aircraft-system fault-tree analysis, this unit examines OR logic for either triggering failure. When either event causes the top event, the independent union subtracts overlap; simple addition is only a small-probability approximation.
steps.observation: 本單元為獨立假想台架，與其他單元尺寸及負載不可直接拼接。原創教學假設，非機型實測或操作值：假想事件pA=0.1、pB=0.2。關係式 POR=1-(1-pA)(1-pB)；含輸出單位換算的算式 1-(1-0.1)*(1-0.2)，結果 0.28 probability。適用範圍：獨立事件教學，不適用有條件依賴的任意故障樹。
steps.observationEn: This unit uses an independent hypothetical bench; dimensions and loads must not be combined with other units without reconciliation. Original teaching assumptions, not aircraft measurements or operating settings: Hypothetical probabilities pA=0.1 and pB=0.2. Relation POR=1-(1-pA)(1-pB); evaluated expression including output-unit conversion 1-(1-0.1)*(1-0.2) gives 0.28 probability. Applicability: Independent-event exercise, not arbitrary dependent fault trees.
steps.failure: 在「任一故障觸發的OR邏輯」的情境中，重複基本事件出現在兩分支時，直接假設分支獨立會錯算。
steps.failureEn: In the context of OR logic for either triggering failure, Repeated basic events in branches invalidate naive branch independence.
steps.check: 針對「任一故障觸發的OR邏輯」，用四格事件表列無故障、A、B及兩者，再核對總和為一。 保留單位、條件及原始計算，並以另一種可能原因作對照。
steps.checkEn: For OR logic for either triggering failure, List none, A, B and both in a four-cell table and check normalization. Retain units, conditions and raw calculations, and compare one alternative explanation.

knowledge.text: 只把 pB 改為0.05，其餘條件固定。用 1-(1-0.1)*(1-0.05) 重算，結果從 0.28 變成 0.145 probability。先預測方向，再記下對「任一故障觸發的OR邏輯」的意義與一項不能外推的結論。只在離線模型或紙上完成。
